3D Plots in the Grammar of Graphics

Source: R/ggplot3d-package.R
ggplot3d-package.Rd

Three-dimensional layers, z position scales and camera controls for ggplot2. Panel scenes resolve visibility across layers for vector and raster output. When attaching ggcube or ggrgl together with ggplot3d, use qualified calls such as ggplot3d::coord_3d() for names shared by the packages.

Options

ggplot3d.threads

Number of threads the scene compiler and the raster backend use. The default 0 uses every logical core; at most 2 are used when _R_CHECK_LIMIT_CORES_ is set. The compiled scene is the same for every thread count. Accepts representable nonnegative integers; see backend_3d().

ggplot3d.cache_bytes

Memory, in bytes, kept for recently compiled scenes, so that redrawing a plot at the same size and view skips the compiler. Accepts one nonnegative number or Inf. Defaults to 256 MiB; 0 turns the cache off. See coord_3d().

ggplot3d.max.overlaps

Default max.overlaps of geom_text_repel_3d() and geom_label_repel_3d(): a label that overlaps more labels and points than this where it starts is not drawn. Accepts one nonnegative number or Inf. Defaults to 10.

ggplot3d.vector_markers

Maximum markers per vector panel: one nonnegative whole number or Inf for unlimited. Default 50000. See geom_point_3d().

ggplot3d.shading_tolerance

One positive finite number for the encoded sRGB tolerance of vector shading. Default 2 / 255. See geom_surface_3d().

ggplot3d.smooth_vector

"auto" (default) or "subdivide" for smooth faces in vector output. See geom_surface_3d().

ggplot3d.smooth_dpi

One positive finite number for the minimum resolution of smooth shading images. Default 150. See geom_surface_3d().

ggplot3d.quadric_segments

One representable integer of at least 3 for quadric meshes in exports and shadows. Default 32. See geom_sphere_3d().
